title: pvAppendMolecule
body:
## pvAppendMolecule

Appends one or more molecules (vtkMolecule) into a single molecule containing all atoms and bonds with their atom and bond data. The inputs must carry the same data arrays (same number and names). Use it to assemble a system from several molecule readers or pvConvertIntoMolecule nodes before bonding, rendering or export.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- VTK merges atoms at identical positions by default (MergeCoincidentAtoms, not exposed in ParaView), so overlapping copies of a structure collapse into one.
- Inputs with differing atom or bond arrays are not reconciled; give all inputs the same arrays.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AppendMolecule`. Identity: `filters/AppendMolecule`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. Accepted data: molecules (vtkMolecule). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkMolecule"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAppendMolecule",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
